prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1250; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the above-named individual in connection with injuries sustained in a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the other vehicle, insured under your policy, struck our client while our client was turning left. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, including any applicable excess or umbrella coverage. Please also provide a complete copy of the declarations page for that policy.

Your insured and your company have a duty to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, claim file materials, witness statements, recorded calls, and any repair or total loss records for both vehicles. Please ensure that this evidence is retained and not altered, repaired, or discarded while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt response.
